company.name: SmartWTI
company.shortDescription: SmartWTI is a provider of Internet of Things and AI solutions that specializes in creating and manufacturing water management solutions.
company.description: SmartWTI is a provider of Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI) solutions that specializes in creating and manufacturing water management solutions to support IoT.

productsAndServices.description: A system that helps individuals and organizations conserve and manage water by tracking and controlling water consumption and quality, and predicting water consumption using AI algorithms.
productsAndServices.name: Smart WTI-Water Management Solution

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based solution for remote equipment monitoring, controlling, and management of water and other liquids using web and mobile applications.
productsAndServices.name: AI/IoT Cloud-solution

productsAndServices.description: Various sensors for measuring parameters such as dissolved oxygen, temperature, pH, ORP, conductivity, salinity, turbidity, suspended solids, COD, BOD, TOC, SAC254, radar level, temperature, humidity, pressure, luminosity, and ultrasound.
productsAndServices.name: Sensors

productsAndServices.description: Additional components like GPS modules, Li-ion rechargeable and non-rechargeable batteries, and rigid solar panels.
productsAndServices.name: Accessories

productsAndServices.description: Solutions for metering, monitoring, and controlling water and oil storage, leak detection, truck management, industrial water management, irrigation, water quality monitoring, wastewater control, water distribution network management, swimming pool measurement, fish farm management, and hydroponics and aquarium management.
productsAndServices.name: Applications of IoT for Water & Other Liquids Management

insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $30,538, representing 100% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 63 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 47 (-40).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
